hooks.command: WS="${PSEO_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}"; MARKER="${WS}/shared/active.json"; if [ -n "$WS" ] && [ -f "$MARKER" ]; then   PID=$(grep -oE '"active_project"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null         | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/');   echo "PSEO context: workspace=$WS project=${PID:-<none>}"; else   echo "PSEO context: no active project bound — run /pseo-bootstrap-project or set PSEO_WORKSPACE_ROOT"; fi; echo "Drift router: when uncertain about next step invoke the meta:whats-next skill (Phase 5+) — until then consult docs/PHASE_STATUS.md."
